name: Conveyor Bench — Demo Baseline: generated machine view
truthBoundary: Shows simulated physical truth (generated world raw image and entities) and observed PLC outputs from host-supplied snapshots. Not the PLC HMI and not evidence of PLC correctness. No credentials, network access or command authority.
layoutAssumptions: Scale is 200 px per metre for all paths; main lane runs horizontally at y=300 from x=80 (0 m) to x=920 (4.2 m).
Exit A and Exit B chutes branch 35 degrees downward from the main lane at 1.6 m and 2.8 m respectively, each 1.1 m long; branch point coordinates exactly match the main path points at those stations.
Geometry stations are the generated world's inferred demo layout, not measured dimensions or PLC thresholds.
Divert paddles pivot at the north lane edge (local -18,-20): 0 percent lies along the lane edge, 100 percent rotates 55 degrees clockwise visibly across the main lane toward the exit branch below.
Drive, encoder and stack light have no specified location and are therefore shown only in a clearly labelled side panel at x=950..1185 implying no measured location.

Colour meaning: purple squares are observed PLC outputs (data-cb-source plc), teal/amber/green circles are simulated world truth (data-cb-source world); PLC command on never by itself paints a device as physically moving, feedback is shown separately.

Unknown (before first snapshot) is white fill with grey dashed stroke, visually distinct from false which is solid light grey; true world photoeyes are amber, true feedbacks green, overload/red lamp red when true.
Carton template is 60 px long (0.3 m at 200 px/m) by 36 px high, centred on its local origin along +x; route/jam appearance is host-supplied per clone.
Belt marks repeat every 40 px and are clipped to the main belt; their offset is driven solely by the host belt binding from Encoder_Count.
